defect: File reader requests followed original group order, while the consumer used stable dense-first order. Sequential take(row) ignored row and could associate a sample's value/slope and q span with another physical frequency. The indexed device-backed route did not have this mismatch.
fix: Use one stable processing order for filtering, file reader requests and consumption; preserve original carry row IDs; witness each requested row/q span and paired value/slope shape before consumption.
scope: A confirmed deterministic data-association defect, not yet a measured explanation of the entire material Gram residual. The fine-grid replay also refused, so the earlier q4 refusal cannot be attributed solely to the real-space cutoff. No BSE, Sigma or TD completion occurred in either failed client.
